short: WESPER trains a whisper-to-normal converter with no paired data (M02, ahead); its unit route (M06) is untested against baselines, and its ASR gain trails a recognizer fine-tuned on labelled whisper.
position: WESPER [@rekimoto2023wesper] changes two components: training without paired recordings (M02), which is ahead, and conversion through self-supervised units (M06), which is standard because it is never compared with a spectral or paired baseline. Later work also trains on synthetic whisper without real pairs [@ritter2026floww2n]. The speech-recognition claim is the weakest: conversion lowers cloud-ASR WER from 44.70% to 26.68% on an unstated wTIMIT subset that pretraining also used, while its own Table 2 gives 13.75% without conversion for a HuBERT recognizer fine-tuned on labelled wTIMIT speech. "Zero-shot" covers the input speaker only, since each target voice needs 26 hours of decoder training time, and "realtime" is an utterance-level processing ratio without latency (M13). The disorder results rest on five and four speakers, one sentence each, rated for quality rather than intelligibility.
